📚 Essential Reading: Before You Begin

The curriculum builds on concepts we've explored in previous issues. Here's your pre-flight reading list:

Where Do You Sit? The Four PMM Archetypes

Discover whether you're a Creator, Strategist, Operator, or Evangelist — and how AI will transform your role differently based on your archetype. This directly feeds into the Where Do You Sit assessment.

The 10x PMM Scorecard

Rate yourself across Content, Competitive Intelligence, and Demand Generation. The scorecard assessment in the curriculum helps you identify where AI can 10x your output.

The Full-Stack Buyer

Understand how AI is creating buyers who research, compare, and decide without ever talking to sales. Unit 1 of the curriculum expands on this transformation.

🎓 Start Your Curriculum Journey

The 10x PMM Curriculum isn't just reading — it's an interactive learning experience designed to transform how you work. Here's what's inside:

🎯

Interactive Assessments

Start with "Where Do You Sit?" and the "10x Scorecard" to establish your baseline and identify your growth areas.

What's in Unit 1: The AI Transformation

Unit 1 sets the foundation by exploring how AI is fundamentally changing the PMM discipline:

  • The Last Mile Problem — Why traditional PMM approaches are hitting diminishing returns
  • From Customer Journeys to Agent Queries — How buyers are changing
  • The Inference-to-Declaration Spectrum — A new framework for understanding customer data
  • The Two Storefronts — Building for humans AND AI agents

Currently unlocked: Introduction, Assessments, and Unit 1

SAP Unveils the "Autonomous Enterprise" at Sapphire

200+ AI agents, the SAP Knowledge Graph, and Joule Assistants across finance, supply chain, and CX. The Autonomous Close promises to cut financial close from weeks to days.

GrowthLoop: 77% of "Winning" Tests Fail at Scale

87% of marketers use AI, but only 23% can link actions to outcomes. Companies with a single source of truth saw 44% revenue growth vs 8% without. Data foundations matter.

📊 Chart of the Week

The Ambition-Execution Gap

From Adobe's 2026 Executive Survey of 7,000 leaders:

Want to deploy agentic AI 87%
Have unified data foundations 34%
Can link AI actions to outcomes 23%

Source: Adobe/Oxford Economics Executive Survey, May 2026

The takeaway: Everyone wants agentic AI. Few have the foundations to make it work. The curriculum teaches you how to build those foundations — starting with understanding the transformation itself.
